summary: Unwraps a cloudfile value into its name and URL, for display or download links.
description: Cloud File takes a `cloudfile`-typed value — produced by Upload File or stored on a record's file property — and exposes its `name` and `url` as strings. It performs no requests; it is a value adapter between the opaque cloud-file handle and the string-typed inputs the UI actually wants (an Image `src`, a link, a caption).
whenToUse: Whenever a file handle needs to become a URL or filename. Note the cloudfile→image typecast lets a cloudfile feed an Image `src` directly; reach for Cloud File when you need the URL as a *string* or the file's name.

ports.url: The file's URL as a string, for an Image `src` or a link. It's the address the backend answered from, so don't save it into a text property. Save the file itself into a file-typed one.
ports.name: The stored file's name.
